peer_group: Scaled security platforms (CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Fortinet, Check Point)
peers_intro: Forward multiples for the four scaled security platforms PANW is actually compared against. Note how wide the range is: the cohort spans a no-growth incumbent to a hyper-growth cloud name, so these bracket the answer rather than set it. EV/FCF is derived as EV/Sales ÷ free-cash-flow margin, so it is on the same basis for every name.
figures_intro: PANW's fiscal year ends 31 July, so FY2027 is the first full year that includes CyberArk. Revenue and free cash flow are analyst consensus (51 analysts); non-GAAP EPS is derived from consensus revenue at the company's own margin targets, because consensus EPS on a GAAP basis is not comparable to the peer P/Es above. Deliberately, no GAAP earnings figure is used anywhere in this model.
fundamentals_source: FY2027 revenue $13.83B and adjusted free cash flow $5.25B are analyst consensus. Non-GAAP EPS $4.05 is derived, not consensus: $13.83B revenue × 30% non-GAAP operating margin (FY2026 guidance was 28.9–29.2%, with a stated long-term target in the low-to-mid 30s), plus ~$0.15B other income, taxed at PANW's 22% non-GAAP rate, over ~825M diluted shares. For context, consensus GAAP net income for the same year is only $1.53B — roughly a third of free cash flow — which is exactly why a GAAP P/E on this stock reads above 100× and carries no information.

market.commentary: Close on 13 August 2026, at an all-time high and up roughly 114% year to date. Shown here only to be explained, not to be beaten: the fair value above is computed without reference to it.

expectations.commentary: Each path takes the FY2027 revenue above, compounds it three years to FY2030, applies a free-cash-flow margin, and solves for the one number left over: the multiple PANW would still have to command in 2030 for today's price to be right. FY2030 is the horizon because it is the company's own planning horizon — management targets $20B of next-generation-security ARR by then, raised from $15B.

paths.name: Consensus-ish
paths.comment: Growth decelerating from 21% to mid-teens as the CyberArk contribution laps, at the company's stated 40% FCF margin.

paths.name: Company plan ($20B ARR)
paths.comment: Management's own FY2030 plan delivered in full: $20B NGS ARR plus legacy revenue is roughly $24B total, at the 40% margin target.

paths.name: Plan + margin upside
paths.comment: The plan delivered and cash conversion pushed five points past the target — about as good as this business plausibly gets.
